description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Justworks builds products that help businesses manage HR issues and focus on running their businesses. The Associate Software Engineer, Frontend develops frontend web applications for internal and public use, delivering customer-facing capabilities with attention to design, performance, and security.
Frontend software engineer building, testing, and deploying web applications and high-fidelity user interfaces

Responsibilities:
• Gather requirements
• Partner with your team lead to produce clean, effective, on-brand user experiences
• Implement designs with a high level of fidelity
• Research design patterns and propose technical solutions to common web UI/UX problems
• Coding, testing, and deploying modern web apps

Requirements:
• You have experience building web applications, are comfortable ramping up on an existing product quickly, and seek opportunities to continue to grow
• You've mastered at least one frontend framework, and know how to build highly reliable, modular systems that many people can collaborate on at the same time without stepping on each other's toes
• You have a strong sense for good design, and won't stop until the user experience is just right
• Experience with JS/HTML/CSS and at least one framework such as React, Vue, etc
• Working knowledge in at least one server side language, such as Ruby, Python, Golang, etc

Preferred:
• prior experience
